answers.core:
This is core, as it simply expands on the existing concept of feature tag overrides, in a way you would expect.
I don't think it's doable as an addon.
answers.workaround:
Not really, at least not in the export preset case (unless some editor plugin could do it somehow?). I guess you can duplicate the entire preset for debug/release but it defeats the purpose, right?

In the autoload node case, maybe you could have code that replaces the node, or adds a platform-specific child node with the implementation, but you'd probably have to include the reference to all platforms on each platform, which is not right.

title: Allow feature tag overrides in `[autoload]` nodes and `export_presets.cfg` fields
